import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem bounded_odd_power_residue_mod_six (B : ℕ) : ∀ n < B, 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 6 = 2 := by
  intro n hn
  have h₁ : 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 6 = 2 := by
    have h₂ : ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ^ (2 * k + 1) % 6 = 2 := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        norm_num 
      | succ k ih =>
        simp [pow_add, pow_mul, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.add_mod] at ih ⊢
        <;> norm_num at ih ⊢ <;> omega
    exact h₂ n
  exact h₁

import Aesop

set_option autoImplicit false

theorem bounded_odd_power_residue_mod_six (B : ℕ) : ∀ n < B, 2 ^ (2 * n + 1) % 6 = 2 := by
  have h : ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ^ (2 * k + 1) % 6 = 2 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        norm_num
    | succ k ih =>
        calc
          2 ^ (2 * Nat.succ k + 1) % 6 =

                rw [
